summary: KB Financial Group filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resolution on April 23, 2026 to cancel 3,811,944 common shares (estimated value KRW 600 billion) that will be acquired on the Korea Exchange from April 24 to July 20, 2026 via KB Securities. The cancellation, based on Article 343-1 of the Korean Commercial Code, reduces outstanding shares without reducing paid-in capital. No premium or advisor is noted. This is a capital return event returning cash to shareholders. Watch execution of the open-market buyback and the cancellation timeline; risk-arb is minimal as no takeover premium exists.
